title: IAF Recruitment 2026 – Agniveervayu Intake 02/2027
overview: The Indian Air Force invites applications for the Agniveervayu Intake 02/2027 for unmarried male and female candidates. The selection process involves an online test, physical fitness test, and medical examination for a 4-year engagement period. Successful candidates will receive a monthly salary package and a terminal Seva Nidhi benefit upon completion of service.
description:
Post Name

Agniveervayu (Intake 02/2027)

Vacancy Details

The document does not specify the total number of vacancies. Vacancies are allocated state-wise and will be used for the preparation of the Provisional Select List (PSL).

Pay Scale

  • 1st Year: ₹30,000/- per month
  • 2nd Year: ₹33,000/- per month
  • 3rd Year: ₹36,500/- per month
  • 4th Year: ₹40,000/- per month
  • Additional Benefits: Risk and Hardship allowances, Dress and Travel allowances, Ration, Clothing, Accommodation, and Leave Travel Concession (LTC).
  • Terminal Benefit: 'Seva Nidhi' package of approximately ₹10.04 Lakhs (including interest) upon completion of 4 years.

Educational Qualification

  • Science Subjects: Intermediate/10+2/Equivalent with Mathematics, Physics, and English with minimum 50% marks in aggregate and 50% marks in English; OR Three years Diploma Course in Engineering with 50% marks in aggregate and 50% marks in English; OR Two years Vocational Course with non-vocational subjects (Physics and Mathematics) with 50% marks in aggregate and 50% marks in English.
  • Other than Science Subjects: Intermediate/10+2/Equivalent in any stream/subjects with minimum 50% marks in aggregate and 50% marks in English; OR Two years Vocational Course with minimum 50% marks in aggregate and 50% marks in English.

Age Limit

  • Birth Date Range: Candidates born between 01 July 2005 and 01 January 2010 (both dates inclusive).
  • Upper Age Limit: 22 years as on the date of enrolment.

Application Fee

Fee: ₹550/- plus 18% GST (Non-refundable).

Selection Process

  1. Phase-I: Online Test (Objective type).
  2. Phase-II: Physical Fitness Test (PFT), Adaptability Test-I, and Adaptability Test-II.
  3. Phase-III: Medical Examination.

Exam Pattern

  • Science Subjects: 60 minutes duration; comprises Physics, Mathematics, and English (10+2 CBSE syllabus).
  • Other than Science Subjects: 45 minutes duration; comprises English (10+2 CBSE syllabus) and Reasoning & General Awareness (RAGA).
  • Marking Scheme: 1 mark for every correct answer, 0 marks for unattempted, and 0.25 marks deducted for each wrong answer.

Important Dates

Event Date
Online Registration 06 July 2026 to 26 July 2026
Online Exam 22-23 September 2026
PSL Display Last week of May 2027
Enrolment List Publication After 01 June 2027

How to Apply

  1. Visit the official portal at https://iafrecruitment.edcil.co.in.
  2. Step-I: Register using personal and contact details to receive User-ID and password via email/SMS.
  3. Step-II: Log in to fill in personal, communication, and qualification details.
  4. Upload required documents (Photograph, Signature, Parent's Signature, Left Thumb Impression, and Live Image).
  5. Submit the application and pay the fee via the online payment gateway.
  6. Print the submitted application form for future reference.

Important Notes

  • Eligibility: Only unmarried Indian male and female candidates are eligible.
  • Marital Status: Candidates must not marry during the 4-year engagement period.
  • Pregnancy: Female candidates must not be pregnant during the engagement period.
  • Tattoos: Permanent body tattoos are generally not permitted (exceptions for inner forearms and tribal customs).
  • Status: Agniveervayu are not entitled to Ex-Servicemen (ESM) status after discharge.
  • Documentation: Candidates must carry a colour printout of the provisional Admit Card and original AADHAAR card to the exam centre.
  • Warning: The selection process is "Fair & Transparent" and on merit only; beware of touts.
